Create a highly detailed, cinematic portrait of a young anime character in a close-up, full-body shot. The subject is a teenage boy with:

Use high definition and dramatic contrast to make the subject pop against the background. The final image should evoke the feeling of a crucial moment in a story, with the character exuding a sense of both danger and allure. Ensure that every detail, from the hair strands to the subtle red aura, is rendered with maximum clarity and precision.
